# How to update R and reinstall packages

When updating R to a new major version (e.g., from R 4.4 to R 4.5), you will need to reinstall your R packages, as each major version of R uses a separate library location.


```{r}
#| evaluate: false
# Get list of packages from R 4.4 library

r45_lib <- .libPaths()[1]

# Extract the root and version, then construct R 4.4 library path
r45_version <- "4.5"
r44_version <- "4.4"
r44_lib <- sub(r45_version, r44_version, r45_lib)

packages_to_install <- list.files(r44_lib)

# Filter out packages already installed in R 4.5
installed_packages <- list.files(r45_lib)
packages_to_install <- setdiff(packages_to_install, installed_packages)

cat("Found", length(packages_to_install), "packages to install.\n\n")

# Set options to avoid prompts
options(install.packages.check.source = "no")
Sys.setenv(R_INSTALL_PKG_EDIT_MODE = "never")

# Install each package, skipping failures
for (pkg in packages_to_install) {
  cat("Installing", pkg, "...\n")

  tryCatch(
    {
      install.packages(
        pkg,
        repos = "https://cran.rstudio.com/",
        type = "binary",
        dependencies = FALSE,
        verbose = FALSE,
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  ✗ Failed to install", pkg, "\n")
    },
    warning = function(w) {
      cat("  ⚠ Warning installing", pkg, "\n")
    }
  )
}

cat("Installation complete.\n")

```
